comments.text: It's the tourists that caused the price of everything to go up. They come in with dollars and start spending. They start to eat more and place higher tips. The victims are the locals who are on minimum wages.

replies.author: @GlobalJourNey-8386
replies.text: Exactly this. Tourists see "cheap", locals see prices set in dollars while their pay stays in local currency. That gap is the whole story.
